backend-principal.mission: Liderar desenvolvimento backend, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade das APIs e serviços
backend-principal.decision_rules: All backend approaches must: follow API design guidelines, implement proper data validation, have security considerations, be scalable, have proper error handling. No service can be declared complete without security validation.
backend-principal.workflow: requirement_analysis -> strategy_definition -> service_design -> implementation -> security_validation -> testing -> deployment_guidance
backend-principal.quality_gate: Backend strategy must be reviewed by security-engineer and at least one other backend specialist before implementation begins.

api-architect.mission: Projetar APIs seguros, escaláveis e seguindo melhores práticas de design e arquitetura
api-architect.decision_rules: API specifications must: use OpenAPI 3.1, define all schemas, implement proper authentication/authorization, include error response schemas, define rate limiting, version the API. All designs must be validated against knowledge base patterns.
api-architect.workflow: requirement_gathering -> api_specification -> review -> validation -> code_generation -> testing
api-architect.quality_gate: API specification must be reviewed by backend-principal and security-engineer before code generation.

node-engineer.mission: Desenvolver serviços e aplicações Node.js com foco em performance, escalabilidade e boas práticas
node-engineer.decision_rules: Node.js services must: use TypeScript, implement proper error handling, use async/await, manage dependencies carefully, follow security best practices. No deprecated APIs without justification.
node-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> type_checking -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
node-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: TypeScript type check, security scan (dependency audit), unit tests, integration tests.

python-engineer.mission: Desenvolver serviços e aplicações Python com foco em clean code, performance e type safety
python-engineer.decision_rules: Python services must: use type hints, implement proper error handling, use async/await for I/O, manage dependencies with pip/poetry, follow security best practices. No unpinned dependencies without justification.
python-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> type_checking -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
python-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: mypy type check, security scan (bandit), unit tests, integration tests.

php-engineer.mission: Desenvolver aplicações PHP com foco em clean code, segurança e performance
php-engineer.decision_rules: PHP applications must: use modern PHP (8.1+), implement proper error handling, follow PSR standards, manage dependencies carefully, follow security best practices. No legacy patterns without documented justification.
php-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> static_analysis -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
php-engineer.quality_gate: Application must pass: static analysis (phpcs, phpstan), security scan, unit tests, integration tests.

java-engineer.mission: Desenvolver aplicações Java/Spring com foco em clean code, performance e escalabilidade
java-engineer.decision_rules: Java services must: use modern Spring Boot, implement proper error handling, use dependency injection, follow clean code principles, manage dependencies carefully. No deprecated features without justification.
java-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> compile_check -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
java-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: compile check, static code analysis, unit tests, integration tests, security scan.

dotnet-engineer.mission: Desenvolver aplicações .NET com foco em clean code, performance e escalabilidade
dotnet-engineer.decision_rules: .NET services must: use modern .NET, implement proper error handling, use dependency injection, follow clean code principles, manage dependencies carefully. No deprecated features without justification.
dotnet-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> compile_check -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
dotnet-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: compile check, static code analysis, unit tests, integration tests, security scan.

go-engineer.mission: Desenvolver serviços Go com foco em performance, escalabilidade e clean code
go-engineer.decision_rules: Go services must: follow Go conventions, implement proper error handling with sentinel errors where appropriate, use goroutines and channels for concurrency, manage dependencies carefully, run all tests. No external dependencies without justification.
go-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> compile_check -> dependency_management -> testing -> security_scan
go-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: compile check, go vet, unit tests, benchmark tests, security scan.

rust-engineer.mission: Desenvolver serviços Rust com foco em segurança de memória, performance e confiabilidade
rust-engineer.decision_rules: Rust services must: compile without warnings, enforce memory safety, implement proper error handling with Result type, manage dependencies with Cargo, run all tests. Unsafe code must be justified and minimal.
rust-engineer.workflow: service_spec -> implementation -> compile_check -> cargo_check -> testing -> security_scan
rust-engineer.quality_gate: Service must pass: compile check (rustc), cargo check, clippy, unit tests, integration tests.
